What Giskard sells

  • Continuous Red Teaming: Deliberate attacks test security risks and failures specific to a business.
  • LLM Evaluation: Automated checks and expert review assess model behavior.
  • AI Guardrails
  • Giskard Hub: A platform for businesses to test and review AI.
  • Phare LLM Benchmark
